notes: card: peaks on surname pieces after Italian given names (Leonardo Bonafede, Giovanni Sforza, Giacomo Moro, Horacio Gianello); + pole fires on Sicilian/Italian place names (Taormina, Bari, Sicilian). Probes: Bellini 0.81, Gian Lorenzo 0.83, Medici 0.67, Puccini 0.40, Dickens 0.03. Near misses: the same sentences with non-Italian names, or Italian places instead of people.
